base: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: standalone game catalogue cover for GameNight Host, ONE single full-bleed LANDSCAPE image, 3:2 aspect ratio, high-resolution around 2048 x 1360. This is actual production illustration, NOT a website screenshot, poster sheet, contact sheet or physical box. Premium cinematic illustrated key art, exquisite semi-realistic digital painting with sophisticated animated-feature lighting, tactile materials, believable expressive adult characters, finely drawn hands, crisp controlled details, professional visual storytelling. Beautiful vibrant amethyst, rich cobalt blue, luminous cyan and radiant pink accents, tastefully contrasted with warm amber. COLORFUL and inviting, not muddy, monochrome, overly dark, grainy or generic. Scene must be visible at small card size. Compose a MEDIUM WIDE establishing scene with breathing room: main characters and decisive objects entirely within the central 65% of the image, complete heads and hands, meaningful surrounding environment visible. Keep 15% clear atmospheric padding on both sides; do not zoom into faces. Balance objects at multiple depths. Avoid crowded collages. The source must work as a landscape cover and central square crop. Natural luminosity and coherent color grading; elegant magic only when thematically appropriate. NO text, letters, numbers, title, logo, watermark, border, panel, UI, labels, typography or readable card faces.

jobs.name: GameNight Cards

Cozy velvet sofas, candlelight, houseplants, a rainy twilight window with violet skyline. Main couple seen waist-up at comfortable distance, whole hands and table visible. Warm coral/amber faces against enchanting lavender and cyan evening light. Emotional closeness, elegant intimate energy, no giant foreground face.
